# Cashflow engineering instructions
Read README.md, docs/architecture.md and docs/requirements.md before editing.

- Preserve dependency direction: domain has no external imports; application depends on domain and ports; infrastructure implements ports; presentation calls use cases; main assembles adapters.
- Money is integer BRL cents, never binary floats. Explicit business_date uses the Sao Paulo business calendar. Entries are immutable.
- Commit entry plus outbox atomically. Never call summary, broker or AI in the ledger HTTP transaction.
- Delivery is at least once. Inbox deduplication and daily aggregation must share a transaction. Reject same identity with different content.
- A repeated Idempotency-Key with different payload is HTTP 409.
- Keep AI optional and read-only. No SQL generated by LLM, no posting transactions, no source without citation. facts is deterministic; valid citation IDs do not prove truth.
- Never add real financial data or credentials to corpus, prompts, tests, Git or logs.
- Use python -m pytest -q; ruff check .; ruff format --check .
- For persistence, concurrency or delivery changes run PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/verify_runtime.py --seconds 30.
- State what was actually verified. A test double does not establish live Anthropic compatibility. Local SQLite tests do not certify production HA.
- Keep requirement traceability, ADRs and OpenAPI contracts aligned with changes.
